rows.name: Gambler's ring
rows.ex: A rare drop, from the Yard's boars and hornworms.

rows.name: Bookie's amulet
rows.ex: A rare drop, from highwaymen and Bog Gnashers.

rows.name: Card sharp's gloves
rows.ex: A rare drop. There's still a card up one sleeve.

rows.name: Angel's ring
rows.ex: A rare drop. Somebody up there owes you one.

rows.name: Ditched hood
rows.ex: Wet through and smells of the river. Nobody asks you to take it off.

rows.name: Ditched coat
rows.ex: Somebody went in the water rather than be caught wearing this. It still fits.

rows.name: Ditched gloves
rows.ex: Soft, thin, worn through at the fingertips. Not from work.

rows.name: Ditched boots
rows.ex: Soft soles. You can hear how quiet they are just holding them.

rows.name: Hallowed helm
rows.ex: The Pumpkin King's, or a copy. Lit from inside. Dragonstone-grade, and every kill in it pays a little more.

rows.name: Hallowed cuirass
rows.ex: Black iron with a pumpkin burning on the chest. Dragonstone-grade.

rows.name: Hallowed greaves
rows.ex: The seams glow. Dragonstone-grade.

rows.name: Gallows Bow
rows.ex: Cut from the gallows tree. One chop in ten thousand brings it down, during the Long Night only. Kills pay 6% more and rare drops come 10% easier.

rows.name: Lantern Quiver
rows.ex: A carved pumpkin with a strap. One arrow in four flies back into it: a quarter of your shots spend nothing. The King drops it; Hexa sells it.

rows.name: Shroud Satchel
rows.ex: Sewn from a burial shroud, and deeper than it looks: it holds 3,000 pages, twice any other bag at its level. A quarter of your casts spend no page. The King drops it; Hex

rows.name: Drowned Boots
rows.ex: They came up on a line. One cast in ten thousand, during the Long Night only. You move, swing and fish 8% faster, and kills pay 3% more.

rows.name: Coffin Ring
rows.ex: Coffin iron, with a coffin on it. One swing in ten thousand at any rock turns it up, during the Long Night only. One dig, cut or catch in ten comes up double.

rows.name: The Reaper's Scythe
rows.ex: Any monster under a fifth of its health dies to the next swing, outright. Never a boss. Kills pay 8% more. The King, one in a hundred; anything of level 80 or more, one i

rows.name: The Ferryman's Coin
rows.ex: Charon's own fare. The hospital never bills you again, and a real ZCoin is 15% more likely to drop. The King, one in a hundred; anything of level 80 or more, one in three

rows.name: Captain Claw's grip
rows.ex: The captain's own gauntlets, shell and all. Nova gloves' defence, a little more bite, a little quicker, a little harder to hurt. Only Captain Claw drops them.

rows.name: Bessemer's Gauntlets
rows.ex: Old Bessemer's own, riveted iron gone black and orange at the knuckles. The lava never got them off him. Only Old Bessemer drops them, one kill in a hundred.

rows.name: Deepwarden's sigil
rows.ex: The Deepwarden's own. Iron, a pink crystal, and the weight of the mountain. More tickets, and you take a little less.

rows.name: The Mountain's Heart
rows.ex: A raw abyss crystal the size of a thumbnail, set in the Deepwarden's own black iron. It is warm. Only the Deepwarden drops it, one kill in a hundred.

rows.name: Sapphire-set dragonstone ring
rows.ex: Dragonstone ring, set with a cut sapphire. Everything the ring had, and 4% more bites.

rows.name: Sapphire-set dragonstone amulet
rows.ex: Dragonstone amulet, set with a cut sapphire. Everything the amulet had, and 8% more bites.

rows.name: Topaz-set starfall ring
rows.ex: Starfall ring, set with a cut topaz. Everything the ring had, and 4% faster at everything.

rows.name: Topaz-set starfall amulet
rows.ex: Starfall amulet, set with a cut topaz. Everything the amulet had, and 8% faster at everything.

rows.name: Opal-set nova ring
rows.ex: Nova ring, set with a cut opal. Everything the ring had, and 6% better drops.

rows.name: Opal-set nova amulet
rows.ex: Nova amulet, set with a cut opal. Everything the amulet had, and 12% better drops.

rows.name: Abyss-set singularity ring
rows.ex: Singularity ring, set with three abyss crystals. Everything the ring had, and 5% more tickets and 3% less damage taken.

rows.name: Abyss-set singularity amulet
rows.ex: Singularity amulet, set with three abyss crystals. Everything the amulet had, and 10% more tickets and 6% less damage taken.

rows.name: Rex-tooth necklace
rows.ex: A cord of gold beads and one of Old Rex's teeth. A little of everything, and rare things turn up 5% more around whoever wears it. Only Old Rex drops it.

rows.name: Yeti-fur boots
rows.ex: Yeti pelt over onyx plates, lined with frost shards that never let the feet go cold. More defence than any metal boot, and you walk 4% faster.
